Where Quoting & estimating goes wrong for Remodelers & carpenters

Remodelling quotes carry change orders, allowances and selections that move after work starts. A quote written without allowances gets renegotiated, usually in the customer's favour.

What Remodelers & carpenters jobs really involve

Remodelling jobs run for weeks, involve change orders and tie up cash in materials before the customer pays. Job costing and progress billing are the difference between a profitable project and one that quietly loses money.

Frequently asked questions

Which quoting & estimating tools work best for remodelers & carpenters?

The three that fit best here are Joist (Solo contractors and small crews who mainly need to quote and get paid), Togal.AI (Contractors who bid from plans and spend hours on manual takeoffs), Knowify (Contractors who need to know whether a job actually made money). Start with the one whose description matches your crew size, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does quoting & estimating software cost for remodelers & carpenters?

Across the 7 tools on this page, 4 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices change often, so treat the figures here as indicative and confirm on the vendor site.

Why does quoting & estimating cause problems for remodelers & carpenters specifically?

Remodelling quotes carry change orders, allowances and selections that move after work starts. A quote written without allowances gets renegotiated, usually in the customer's favour.

How do I stop change orders eating the margin?

Price every change as a separate written order with its own cost and time impact before the work proceeds. Verbal changes agreed on site are where remodelling profit disappears.
